newsitem.title: USA: Gandalf foresees Q2 loss of $8 mln-$9 mln.
newsitem.headline: Gandalf foresees Q2 loss of $8 mln-$9 mln.

text.p: Gandalf Technologies Inc said it anticipates it will report a net loss of about $8 million to $9 million or about $0.18 to $0.21 per share for the second quarter of the 1997 fiscal year quarter.
The company said it reported break-even results for the same period last year, which ends September 28.
It also said it had appointed Richard Busto as president and chief operating officer of the company.
Busto, who was one of the company's vice presidents, will replace Tom Vassiliades, it added.
